scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && concurrently -k -n api,workers,desktop -c blue,magenta,green "npm:dev -w @leads/api" "npm:dev -w @leads/workers" "npm:start -w @leads/desktop"
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @leads/shared && npm run build -w @leads/db
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @leads/api && npm run build -w @leads/workers && npm run build -w @leads/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
